chapter: Arranging, bandleading and Pearl Bailey's life
title: Pearl's siblings and tap dancer Bill Bailey
summary: Pearl came from three girls and one boy; her brother Bill Bailey was a famed tap dancer who toured with them.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did she come from a big family?

Not a big family. There were three girls and one boy. Virgie was the oldest. She just passed away not too long ago. Then Ura was also a good singer. Pearl was the youngest. Bill Bailey was in between. That was a great tap dancer. He was in a class with Baby Laurence, Teddy Hale, Bojangles, Bill Robinson. He did a takeoff on Bill Robinson that was absolutely fabulous. One of the greatest dancers ever. Duke Ellington quoted himself by saying that Bill Bailey was the greatest tap dancer he’d ever heard. And Duke heard quite a few of them.
So you knew Bill? Bill Bailey?
Did you play with him? Did you work together?
Oh yeah. We worked in the show with him. On that tour he was also with us. He was a natural comedian too.
